targets.old_statement: Fake identification felonies threaten seven years and ten thousand dollars for holders and crooked issuers alike.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Fake identification felonies threaten seven years and ten thousand dollars for holders and crooked issuers alike.
targets.statement: Using, carrying, borrowing, or buying a fake identification card is a felony carrying up to seven years in prison and a ten-thousand-dollar fine, and authorized license issuers separately commit a felony if they knowingly help license someone ineligible, untruthful on the application, or using another person's photo.

targets.old_statement: Crashes and convictions anywhere all land on the permanent portable record.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Crashes and convictions anywhere all land on the permanent portable record.
targets.statement: Some collisions along with any Oklahoma or out-of-state court traffic conviction enter the complete driving record maintained by Service Oklahoma and transferred when you apply for licensing in another state.

targets.old_statement: Reckless and school-bus failures top the table at four while equipment and miscellany cost one.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Reckless and school-bus failures top the table at four while equipment and miscellany cost one.
targets.statement: Reckless driving and failing to stop or remain stopped for a loading or unloading school bus carry four points, while operating a defective vehicle and all other violations except those requiring suspension or revocation carry one point.
